final: {"prompt":"Create a square, full-bleed nonrepresentational abstract painting with no border or surrounding setting. Build the composition from layered fields of deep midnight blue, bruised plum, charcoal, and muted rust, cut through by abrupt streaks of hot coral and pale electric amber. Let dense, agitated brushwork gather off-center, with scraped pigment, dry-brush marks, translucent washes, and abrupt shifts in texture. Set that pressure against wide, quiet passages of near-black and smoky violet, leaving asymmetrical pockets of open space. Give the marks a restless rhythm: tight clusters, broken diagonals, and gestures that collide, thin out, and reappear beneath later layers. Create tension through sharp value contrasts and uneven density, while keeping the whole surface painterly and ambiguous. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. The painting must fill the entire square image edge to edge."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
